visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a beige shirt stands outdoors in front of a Korean restaurant named 'Sun Nong Dan.' He gestures enthusiastically with his hands while speaking to the camera. The setting is a sunny parking lot area with palm trees and commercial signage visible in the background. (2) Transition to a yellow screen with the text '直接開吃!' (Let's start eating!). (3) Inside the restaurant, the scene shows a bustling atmosphere with multiple diners at tables. A close-up shot focuses on a large clay pot of meat and cheese being heated with a blowtorch, causing flames to rise. The lighting is warm and indoor. (4) The man is shown sitting at a table, using chopsticks to lift a large, cheese-covered beef short rib from a sizzling platter. He takes a large bite, exhibiting an exaggeratedly joyful facial expression. Visual effects like floating hearts and sparkles are overlaid on the screen. (5) Another yellow transition screen appears with the text '晚上看這支 好餓!' (Watching this at night makes me so hungry!). (6) The man is now inside a supermarket, standing in front of refrigerated beverage shelves. He holds a bottle of 'Synergy' brand Kombucha, gesturing toward it. The lighting is bright fluorescent indoor lighting. (7) Outside the store at night, the man takes a drink from the bottle, wipes his mouth, and gives a thumbs-up to the camera with a satisfied smile.

(4) The speaker's voice becomes more excited and loud. Exaggerated, crisp 'crunch' and 'slurp' foley effects are heard during eating segments, mixed with a continuous driving beat from the BGM.
